description: This script handles crash dump uploading and logging for a device, including functions for locking, logging, file handling, and uploading archives via SCP.

methods.name: exit_impl
methods.description: Exits the script with a given status code.

methods.name: log_info
methods.description: Logs informational messages with process ID and timestamp.

methods.name: log_error
methods.description: Logs error messages with process ID and timestamp.

methods.name: log_fatal
methods.description: Logs an error message and exits with code 255.

methods.name: log_std_out
methods.description: Outputs lines from stdin to log_info.

methods.name: at_exit
methods.description: Performs cleanup tasks and logs on script exit.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Removes lock directory and resets traps.

methods.name: try_lock
methods.description: Creates a lock directory to prevent concurrent script runs.

methods.name: get_last_modified_time_of_file
methods.description: Retrieves the last modification time of a file in a specific format.

methods.name: is_file_size_changing
methods.description: Checks if a file's size is still changing over a period.

methods.name: ud_initialize
methods.description: Initializes environment and parameters for dump upload.

methods.name: ud_compose_filename
methods.description: Creates a filename based on current parameters and SHA1.

methods.name: ud_get_file_timestamp
methods.description: Gets the last modification timestamp of a file.

methods.name: ud_check_log_file
methods.description: Ensures log file exists and is writable.

methods.name: ud_set_mac_address
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve and set the MAC address.

methods.name: ud_set_sha1_sum
methods.description: Calculates and sets the SHA1 checksum of the receiver path.

methods.name: ud_set_model_num
methods.description: Sets device model number based on version file.

methods.name: ud_backup_dump_file_if_needed
methods.description: Backs up dump file if mode is not MINIDUMP.

methods.name: ud_create_dump_archive
methods.description: Creates a tar archive of dump and log files.

methods.name: ud_upload_dump_archive
methods.description: Uploads the dump archive via SCP to the crash portal.

methods.name: ud_cleanup
methods.description: Removes dump archive and dump file.

methods.name: ud_set_dump_file
methods.description: Sets the dump file path and timestamp.

methods.name: ud_upload_dumps
methods.description: Main function to process, archive, and upload dump files.
